# WoW API type: ITEM QUALITY COLORS

From AddOn Studio

Jump to navigation Jump to search

← API types < ITEM QUALITY COLORS

The global array ITEM\_QUALITY\_COLORS is a set of item [quality](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Quality&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Quality (page does not exist)") colors, used to color the item name any place it appears.

## Structure
Each ITEM\_QUALITY\_COLORS[] element returns a table with the same values as API GetItemQualityColor . The keys and values of this table are:

* r (number) - red component of the color (0 to 1, inclusive).
* g (number) - green component of the color (0 to 1, inclusive).
* b (number) - blue component of the color (0 to 1, inclusive).
* hex (string) - a full WoW text color hex string, like 'c|ffcc00ff'. See UI escape sequence

## Values

* 0 - Poor
* 1 - Common
* 2 - Uncommon
* 3 - Rare
* 4 - Epic
* 5 - Legendary
* 6 - Artifact
* 7 - Heirloom
* 8 - WoW Token

## Details

You can refer to them using ITEM\_QUALITY\_COLORS[n], where 'n' is the quality number. The "description" of the item is given using the constant ITEM\_QUALITYX\_DESC, where 'X' is the quality number, which will be localized. The NUM\_ITEM\_QUALITIES global variable holds the count of ITEM\_QUALITY\_COLORS.

## Changes

* [Patch 3.0.2](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_3.0.
2&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 3.0.2 (page does not exist)") introduced quality 7 ( Heirloom ), but neither `ITEM_QUALITY7_DESC` nor `ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[7]` exist as of [Patch 3.0.3](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_3.0.3&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 3.0.3 (page does not exist)") .
* In [Patch 3.1.1](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_3.1.1&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 3.1.1 (page does not exist)") it seems `ITEM_QUALITY7_DESC` is defined as "Heirloom," however `ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[7]` still does not exist, however `GetItemQualityColor(7)` does return the correct colors.
* As of [Patch 5.3.0](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_5.3.0&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 5.3.0 (page does not exist)") , `ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS` and `NUM_ITEM_QUALITIES` both go to 7.
* [Patch 6.1.2](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_6.1.2&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 6.1.
2 (page does not exist)") added quality 8 aqua cyan for [WoW Token](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:WoW_Token&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:WoW Token (page does not exist)") .
* As of [Patch 7.0.3](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_7.0.3&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 7.0.3 (page does not exist)") , purportedly the Heirloom color for `_G["ITEM_QUALITY7_DESC"]` or `ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[7]` has changed from Heirloom `ffe6cc80` ( `` ; the leading `ff` is probably for alpha) to Heirloom `ff00ccff` [[1]]() [ [_citation needed_](https://wildstaronline-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Citation "wildstarwiki:Citation") ] ( `` ). As of current released trial version [Patch 6.2.4](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_6.2.4&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 6.2.4 (page does not exist)") on this 2nd day of July, 2016, the value is still `ffe6cc80` . The color change can be also seen at `[BAG_ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?
title=WoW:BAG_ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:BAG ITEM QUALITY COLORS (page does not exist)")` , but also doesn't show up in-game as of [Patch 7.0.3hotfix15](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Patch_7.0.3hotfix15&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Patch 7.0.3hotfix15 (page does not exist)") .

## References

1. ↑ [Items (Heirloom only)](http://legion.wowhead.com/items/quality:7) . _Legion [Wowhead](https://addonstudio.org/mw1/index.php?title=WoW:Wowhead&action=edit&redlink=1 "WoW:Wowhead (page does not exist)")_ . Retrieved on 2016-06-30.
